newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Three Slovenian shares to debut on OTC on April 14.
newsitem.headline: Three Slovenian shares to debut on OTC on April 14.

text.p: Three Slovenian companies will list their shares on the Ljubljana bourse's over-the-counter (OTC) market on April 14, the bourse said on Friday.

Producer of car lighting equipment Saturnus Avtooprema d.d. will list 370,664 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 2,000 tolars ($13.1) each, representing 65.25 percent of its equity, the bourse said in a press release.
Trading company Kovintrade d.d. will float 74,523 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each, representing 65 percent of its equity.
Textile company Svilanit will list 219,066 shares with a nominal value of 2,000 tolars each, representing 53.38 percent of the firm's equity.
The three companies join a batch of 32 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the bourse since the beginning of last year.
At the moment there are 27 shares traded on the main market and 35 on the OTC.
